system.description:
The ties to your revenant family stayed with you well past the Embrace, so the Disciplines that were innate to you as a ghoul remain so as a Cainite. At character creation, select the revenant family from which you hail; instead of Clan Tzimisce's standard complement of Animalism, Auspex, and Vicissitude, draw your starting Disciplines from your family's three instead (you may still buy other Disciplines with freebie points as normal). You also learn your family Disciplines at clan cost instead of a Tzimisce Discipline — it's either/or, unless a given Discipline happens to be shared by both (such as Vicissitude for the Bratovitch, Obertus, or Zantosa lines).

MET System: You must first clear the heritage of your revenant family with the Storyteller before purchasing this Merit. With Storyteller approval, take the three innate Disciplines of your revenant family at character creation instead of those of Clan Tzimisce. Any Discipline not of your revenant family, even one passed on through Tzimisce blood, must be purchased out-of-clan.
system.source: Clanbook: Tzimisce, Chapter Two: Ego and Evolution
